description: This file defines the 'Css' class, which provides methods for manipulating CSS-related JavaScript functions within a Blazor application. It interacts with JavaScript via IJSRuntime to show or hide the body overflow.

classes.name: Css
classes.description: A class that encapsulates JavaScript interop methods to manipulate CSS styles, specifically for controlling body overflow.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Calls a JavaScript function to show the body overflow.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Calls a JavaScript function to hide the body overflow and returns the result as a string.
